C1268.title: Microsoft Discloses Storm-2372 Device Code Phishing Campaign
C1268.summary: In February 2025, Microsoft disclosed that Storm-2372 had conducted device code phishing since August 2024 against governments, NGOs, and multiple industries. The actor sent lures resembling meeting or messaging-app invitations and induced victims to enter attacker-generated device codes on legitimate sign-in pages. This interaction yielded valid access tokens that could be used to enter accounts and access data while the tokens remained valid.
